message.text:
I need to identify whether the webhook delivery workers consume from NATS or RabbitMQ and locate where the queue is declared.

Webhook workers appear to use an in-memory Go channel (`asyncPostQueue`) in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` instead of NATS or RabbitMQ.
PostAsync was also examined for completeness.

The webhook delivery workers do not use NATS or RabbitMQ. They consume from an in-process buffered Go channel named `asyncPostQueue`, declared in the webhook package.

Four worker goroutines initialize via `init`.
